metadata.title: SIP-6.1 Summer.fi v3 / Lazy Summer Protocol Restart
metadata.description:
# SIP-6.1 Summer.fi v3 / Lazy Summer Protocol Restart
### Summary

Labs Co. is winding down; vaults are withdrawal-only; users of exploited USDC vaults were paid residual via Merkl. This RFC/SIP asks the DAO to choose Option A (rebuild) under a new security-first architecture, delivered by a DAO-hired contributor team (not Labs), with milestone gates and a realistic quote given treasury size.

### Motivation

* Protocol + SUMR brand still exist; UI sunset ≠ protocol death.
* Jul 6 root cause was capped-but-active Ark in NAV + stale valuation + donation path — a rebuild must fix that class of failure, not relaunch the same fleet model.
* Users need a maintained front-end after Aug 31 for redeem/claim UX.
* Wind-down SIPs already cleared Arks; a clean slate for v3 is cheaper than patching v2 forever.

### Non-goals (explicit)

* No claim to restore the stolen ~$6.04M from this budget.
* No immediate reopening of deposit caps.
* No return of BA Labs / Summer Labs as operators unless they re-engage separately.
* No large treasury dump before Phase 0 delivers audited specs.

***

### Product: Summer.fi v3 (Lazy Summer Protocol v3)

Principle: withdrawals always safe; deposits only after Ark lifecycle invariants are enforced on-chain.

Module - ScopeAppMinimal summer.fi successor: portfolio, redeem, Merkl claim deep-link, vault status, Guardian pause banner

Protocol - FleetCommander v3: Ark must be `REMOVED` or `NAV_EXCLUDED` when `depositCap==0` beyond grace; no donation inflation of impaired assets; `totalAssets` uses boardable/principal accounting where possible

Risk - Curator-optional; Guardian retained; mandatory Ark offboarding checklist as on-chain state machine Security requirements (non-negotiable for any reopen)

Drawn from the [https://blog.summer.fi/lazy-summer-usdc-vault-exploit-post-mortem-what-happened-and-what-comes-next/](https://blog.summer.fi/lazy-summer-usdc-vault-exploit-post-mortem-what-happened-and-what-comes-next/)

1. Cap `0` cannot leave Ark in NAV indefinitely (grace + auto `NAV_EXCLUDED` or forced sweep/`removeArk`).
2. Donation of external receipt tokens into Arks must not inflate share price beyond realizable assets (or donations disabled for impaired Arks).
3. Stale external valuations → circuit breaker / haircut oracle.
4. Two independent audits before deposits reopen.
5. Guardian live on every chain where deposits exist.
6. Public Ark registry: state, cap, last NAV contribution, time-in-capped-state.

***

### Team & accountability

* Open RFP on forum: protocol lead, frontend lead, security reviewer.
* Recognized Delegates nominate; SIP confirms.
* Milestone invoices; no upfront annual salary from treasury.
* IP / repos assigned to DAO.

metadata.title: # SIP5.16: Enable transferability of the SUMR Token
metadata.description:
# SIP5.16: Enable transferability of the SUMR Token

## Summary
This proposal enables the transferability of the SUMR token to allow SUMR to begin trading and find its natural market price. The SUMR Token is launching officially on Aerodrome through their Ignition program, starting at 00:00 UTC on the 22nd January 2026. This SIP proposes to allow transferability just prior (from 23:58 UTC on 21st January) so it can start trading immediately. The timing will be controlled by a newly deployed timeguard contract, which will restrict execution of the proposal until after 23:58 UTC.

This SIP proposes enabling transfers on Base. If passed, it should also act as instruction for the Lazy Summer Foundation to enable transfers on the spoke chains of the protocol, including Arbitrum, Ethereum, Sonic and HyperEVM.

## Actions
1. Enable SUMR token transferability on Base at any time after 23:58 UTC on 21st January 2026
2. Instruct the Lazy Summer Foundation to enable transfers on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Sonic and HyperEVM

## References
Discourse: https://forum.summer.fi/t/sip5-16-enable-transferability-of-the-sumr-token/630

metadata.title: SIP5.5.5: November Payouts for Referral Campaign
metadata.description:
# SIP5.5.5: November Payouts for Referral Campaign 
### 1. Overview:

This sub-SIP details the payouts to be made for previously approved referral campaign, detailed here: [\[SIP5.5\] Enable onchain referrals and update AdmiralQuarters contracts on all chains to support Referral Codes](https://forum.summer.fi/t/sip5-5-enable-onchain-referrals-and-update-admiralquarters-contracts-on-all-chains-to-support-referral-codes/202).

The payouts are made on Base and include;

* 52,967.72247 SUMR Tokens
* 1,691.766912 USDC
* Total recipients: 569

***

### 2. Motivation:

The Lazy Summer Protocol’s referral program (as introduced in \[SIP5.5]) requires monthly settlement of rewards earned by referrers and referees.

November’s referral period has concluded, and users have accumulated SUMR and USDC allocations based on activity tracked in the [lazy\_beach\_rewards\_nov25](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AAbzH7uKbRjEEL8ox-3dupN4c6Djzy_kIoBxMvd8kBY/edit?usp=sharing) sheet.

This SIP is necessary to transfer the required tokens to MERKL and enable users to claim their rewards transparently and trustlessly.

#### **2.1 Historical monthly metrics for context:**



| 2025             | July       | August     | September  | October    | November   |
| ---------------- | ---------- | ---------- | ---------- | ---------- | ---------- |
| Total SUMR       | 19,053.765 | 22,272.589 | 40,582.388 | 53,989.690 | 52,967.722 |
| Total USDC       | 687.48     | 789.35     | 1,337.99   | 1,728.54   | 1,691.77   |
| Total Recipients | 227        | 334        | 419        | 547        | 569        |

This SIP ensures continuity of the referral program, maintains user trust, and fulfills previously approved commitments.

***

### 3. Specification:

This SIP does **not** modify smart-contract logic. It authorizes:

* Creation of a new MERKL campaign for November referral rewards.
* Transfer of:
  * 52,967.72247 SUMR
  * 1,691.766912 USDC
    to the MERKL clams contract on Base.

The payout distribution is predefined in the referenced spreadsheet, which details:

* Each referrer’s reward
* Token amounts (SUMR + USDC)

#### **3.1 Execution plan**

1. Upon successful governance approval, and execution, the multisig triggers MERKL campaign creation.
2. SUMR and USDC amounts are transferred from the DAO treasury to the MERKL claims contract.
3. MERKL makes claims available for all eligible November participants.

#### **3.2 Actors responsible**

Lazy Summer DAO - executes the MERKL campaign setup and performs token transfers, while MERKL handles distribution and claim logic.

***

### 4. Risk Assessment:

<u>Technical Risk:</u>

* Low. MERKL infrastructure has been user for prior referral payouts without issue.
* Mitigation: Standard verification of token amounts and campaign parameters before vote.

<u>Economic Risk:</u>

* Minimal. Payouts were already committed under \[SIP5.5] and reflect earned rewards.

<u>Governance / Operational Risk:</u>

* Requires accurate execution by the DAO.
* Mitigation: Public spreadsheet, onchain transparency, and reproducible calculations.

***

### 5. Voting:

> If **YES** - Approve SUMR and USDC disbursement to eligible November participants.

> If **NO** - Do not disburse for November; continue with further discussion.

***


Tagging [@Recognized\_Delegates](https://forum.summer.fi/groups/recognized_delegates) for a check up as always.

–jensei

metadata.title: SIP3.11.2: Delegate Rewards Distribution (November)
metadata.description:
# SIP3.11.2: Delegate Rewards Distribution (November)
### 1. Overview:

This proposal continues the delegate compensation program first approved in [**\[SIP5.6\]**](https://forum.summer.fi/t/sip5-6-retroactive-compensation-for-delegates/229), this time applying it to **November 2025**. The goal is to sustain high-quality governance engagement and reward meaningful participation from active delegates across Lazy Summer Protocol governance.

> Extending [**\[SIP3.11.1\]**](https://forum.summer.fi/t/sip3-11-1-delegate-rewards-distribution-october/451) (October Distribution) to **\[SIP3.11.2]** (November Distribution).

***

### 2. Motivation:

Active and accountable delegates remain a cornerstone of protocol governance. November 2025 featured discussions around offboarding Arbitrum USDC Vault, onbaording new arks across the protocol, and alignment across the Lazy Summer DAO. Compensating delegates for their time and contributions ensures continued accountability and engagement.

***

### 3. Specification:

<u>Rewards Token:</u> [**SUMR**](https://basescan.org/token/0x194f360D130F2393a5E9F3117A6a1B78aBEa1624) - Lazy Summer [**DAO Treasury**](https://basescan.org/address/0x447bf9d1485abdc4c1778025dfdfbe8b894c3796) (Base) <u>Total Distribution Amount:</u> **145,850.00 SUMR** <u>Distribution Schedule:</u> One-time disbursement following onchain approval <u>Eligibility Period:</u> November 1st – November 30th (2025) <u>Distribution Method:</u> Direct transfer to verified delegate wallet addresses

***

### 4. Risk Assessment:

* Onchain vote will authorize SUMR disbursement from the DAO Treasury.
* Delegate participation data was sourced from the [**Lazy Summer Governance Dashboard**](https://dune.com/lazysummer/lazy-summer-dao-governance).
* The final delegate list and breakdown is made publicly available [**here**](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTOcW98nSMK1XdSVZ268c3M6MCqY-xvlr7Ji1GUjk0v9V_iXJfrpqE1wxJW1JcvRAaSb6LApoz3xonx/pubhtml#gid=1549003705).
* Any entity may only receive compensation through a single verified delegate address.
* Suspected Sybil delegates will be excluded, subject to verification by [@Recognized\_Delegates](https://forum.summer.fi/groups/recognized_delegates).

***

### 5. Voting:

> If **YES** - Approve 145,850.00 SUMR disbursement to eligible November delegates

> If **NO** - Do not compensate for November; continue with further discussion.

***

Tagging [@Recognized\_Delegates](https://forum.summer.fi/groups/recognized_delegates) for a check up as always.

–jensei

metadata.title: # SIP5.14: Multi-Chain Raft Address Update
metadata.description:
# SIP5.14: Multi-Chain Raft Address Update

## Summary
This SIP proposes replacing the RAFT contract on each supported network (Base, Arbitrum, Ethereum and Sonic). The upgraded RAFT contract introduces functionality to allow governance to socialize losses within a vault, likely useful once Guardians are introduced who can pause Vaults. 

## Motivation
This SIP is in response to https://forum.summer.fi/t/rfc-arbitrum-usdc-vault-next-steps-dealing-with-usdx-bad-debt/458 and ensuring there is and can be a clear process and clear audit trail onchain.

This upgrade is necessary to enable clear and easy ways for governance to be able to socialize losses within a vault for a particular market, when combined with enabled guardians who can freeze the market while Governance takes action.

It also adds additional protections to sweepable markets, ensuring governance can add certain tokens to a blacklist too. 

## Specifications

Newly deployed raft contracts:
- base: 0x7839d904D05d3D6B5F1D87eb93e1dcD5746AbC6E
- arbitrum: 0x60A81C58F37527FdEcc968FC8B834Ed00b65926d
- mainnet: 0xEcCd16aA1ae0B32b231a3B5FFE8567aBf68616E2
- sonic: 0x2a828B0E5cB549eE568923E815D9A781b6f4F018

### Actions
1. On base: 
   - Set raft address on base to 0x7839d904D05d3D6B5F1D87eb93e1dcD5746AbC6E
2. Send cross-chain proposal to arbitrum to:
   - Set raft address on arbitrum to 0x60A81C58F37527FdEcc968FC8B834Ed00b65926d
2. Send cross-chain proposal to mainnet to:
   - Set raft address on mainnet to 0xEcCd16aA1ae0B32b231a3B5FFE8567aBf68616E2
2. Send cross-chain proposal to sonic to:
   - Set raft address on sonic to 0x2a828B0E5cB549eE568923E815D9A781b6f4F018

## Technical Details
The raft contract is used to handle reward token auctions. It updates the Raft contract to handle tokens with self transfer functionality blocked.

##Risk Assessment 
This SIP introduces no additional risks, but relies on governance to decide how to handle receipt tokens once collected into the treasury after socialized losses and been executed.

##Voting
A **YES** vote for this SIP will replace the existing RAFT contract addresses with the newly deployed RAFT contracts and will be used moving forward.
A **NO** vote would leave the existing RAFT contracts as they are, making no changes to the protocol.

metadata.title: # SIP2.39: Offboard the Silo susdx/usdc (127) market from the Arbitrum USDC Vault using Sweep via Timelock
metadata.description:
# SIP2.39: Offboard the Silo susdx/usdc (127) market from the Arbitrum USDC Vault using Sweep via Timelock

## Summary
It is proposed, based on the recent discussions within [RFC] Arbitrum USDC Vault next steps (Dealing with USDX bad debt) that the Silo susdx/usdc (127) market) is removed from the Arbitrum USDC Vault using sweep via the Timelock.

This action would remove the vault, socializing losses for those remaining in the Vault. At the time of this SIP, 227k USDC liquidity remains in the Vault, with 1.5M USDC bad debt.

It is expected that should this vote pass, by the time of it’s execution, there is likely no more liquidity remaining in the Vault.

## Specification
On Arbitrum, temporarily set ConfigurationManager.raft to the Timelock to enable Ark.sweep(tokens)
to transfer specified tokens to the Timelock, then restore raft to the Raft contract.

## Target Chain
Arbitrum

## Contracts
- ConfigurationManager: 0x8ae7fbAeCfBDb21c28b1854272BB7A3a813e2A66
- Timelock: 0x447BF9d1485ABDc4C1778025DfdfbE8b894C3796
- Raft (restore): 0x2E6FBcefA0480cF9f7920d98804A9BD72e1eFEc9
- Ark (sweep target): 0x54749c15751137Be18768288D3945C4934fCb800

## Tokens
- 0x2433D6AC11193b4695D9ca73530de93c538aD18a

## Actions
1. Set raft to Timelock in ConfigurationManager
2. Ark.sweep(tokens) — executed by Timelock (as temporary raft)
3. Restore raft to Raft in ConfigurationManager

##Risk Assesment
It is not considered to create any risk to the protocol or supporting contracts.

##Voting
A YES vote for this SIP will remove the Silo susdx/usdc (127) market from the Arbitrum USDC Vault, using sweep via the TImelock

A NO vote will result in no changes to the Arbtirum USDC Vault, expecting the vault to be left as is, and rely on the keepers to try and recover any funds that may, at some point, be deposited back into the Silo market.

metadata.title: [SIP3.12] Extend SUMR Rewards for all Lazy Vaults through MERKL
metadata.description: # [SIP3.12] Extend SUMR Rewards for all Lazy Vaults through MERKL ### 1. Overview: Following up from [\[RFC\] Renew Lazy Vault SUMR Rewards from Nov 11th 2025 - #3 by chrisb](https://forum.summer.fi/t/rfc-renew-lazy-vault-sumr-rewards-from-nov-11th-2025/440/3) - this SIP represents the renewing of the vault rewards, while reducing emissions by 25%, applied using a fixed target rate across all vaults. NOTE: Although the RFC used a 12% example, given recent market downtown and reduction in TVL because of it, the numbers have been updated to retain a 25% reduction, which now resets all vaults to 16% APY. *** ### 2. Motivation: To maintain incentives on the Vaults while the protocol continues to grow. *** ### 3. Specification: The following rewards will be added to the vaults; [](https://canada1.discourse-cdn.com/flex009/uploads/summer/original/1X/2bcab66f731f199d69e314fcae980ccf2cdc0169.png "Screenshot 2025-11-06 at 09.36.17") As previously, all rewards will be distributed through MERKL, starting on 11th November (when the current rewards end) and last for 90 days, taking us through to the 9th February 2026. All rewards will again be distributed on Base, regardless of the vault network. The existing staking contracts (which are no longer used) remain as ‘forwarder’ contracts for the purpose of the MERKL rewards, so users who have continued to stake will still benefit from the rewards. *** ### 4. Risk Assessment: No new additional risks identified. *** ### 5. Voting: Voting YES will trigger the MERKL reward creation and transfer a total 22,478,338 SUMR tokens to the Reward Contracts.

metadata.title: # SIP5.13: Multi-Chain Foundation Roles Setup
metadata.description:
# SIP5.13: Multi-Chain Foundation Roles Setup

## Summary
This proposal grants core governance roles to the Lazy Summer Foundation multisig at 0xB0F53Fc4e15301147de9b3e49C3DB942E3F118F2 across all active chains in the Lazy Summer Protocol ecosystem.

Secondly, it is asking the Lazy Summer Foundation to use it's governance role to Whitelist the new Staking Contract on the SUMR token contract on the Base Network, in order to enable the new SUMR staking module.

## Motivation
As part of the RFC to upgrade Governance and Staking to new versions, and in order to prepare for the transferability of SUMR, we would like to propose giving the Lazy Summer Foundation governance roles via their multisig to act as a fallback and to create a more efficient upgrade process. 

The Foundation multisig requires specific roles to manage protocol governance and timelock operations:
- GOVERNOR_ROLE in ProtocolAccessManager for protocol-wide governance
- PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE, CANCELLER_ROLE, and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE in SummerTimelockController for timelock management

## Target Address
Foundation Multisig: 0xB0F53Fc4e15301147de9b3e49C3DB942E3F118F2

## Specifications

### Actions
1. On base: 
   - Grant GOVERNOR_ROLE in ProtocolAccessManager
   - Grant PROPOSER_ROLE in SummerTimelockController
   - Grant EXECUTOR_ROLE in SummerTimelockController
   - Grant CANCELLER_ROLE in SummerTimelockController
   - Grant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE in SummerTimelockController
2. Send cross-chain proposal to arbitrum to:
   - Grant GOVERNOR_ROLE in ProtocolAccessManager
   - Grant PROPOSER_ROLE in SummerTimelockController
   - Grant EXECUTOR_ROLE in SummerTimelockController
   - Grant CANCELLER_ROLE in SummerTimelockController
   - Grant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE in SummerTimelockController
2. Send cross-chain proposal to mainnet to:
   - Grant GOVERNOR_ROLE in ProtocolAccessManager
   - Grant PROPOSER_ROLE in SummerTimelockController
   - Grant EXECUTOR_ROLE in SummerTimelockController
   - Grant CANCELLER_ROLE in SummerTimelockController
   - Grant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE in SummerTimelockController
2. Send cross-chain proposal to sonic to:
   - Grant GOVERNOR_ROLE in ProtocolAccessManager
   - Grant PROPOSER_ROLE in SummerTimelockController
   - Grant EXECUTOR_ROLE in SummerTimelockController
   - Grant CANCELLER_ROLE in SummerTimelockController
   - Grant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE in SummerTimelockController

## Technical Details
- **GOVERNOR_ROLE**: Grants protocol-wide administrative privileges in the ProtocolAccessManager
- **PROPOSER_ROLE**: Allows proposing operations to the TimelockController
- **EXECUTOR_ROLE**: Allows executing operations in the TimelockController
- **CANCELLER_ROLE**: Allows cancelling operations in the TimelockController
- **DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE**: Grants admin privileges in the TimelockController, allowing role management. 

 ## Risk Assessment 
- The main risk here is providing a multisig with sweeping governance powers during the transition from Governance V1 to V2. 

 ## Voting 
 By voting YES to this SIP, you will be voting FOR granting core governance roles, as decribed above, to the Lazy Summer Foundation multisig. As well as granting roles, you will also be using the grant of roles to further instruct the Lazy Summer Foundation to use it's newly granted governance rights to whitelist the new SUMR staking contract on the SUMR Token contract on the Base Network, thus enabling the new SUMR staking contract.

metadata.title: SIP3.11.1: Delegate Rewards Distribution (October)
metadata.description:
# SIP3.11.1: Delegate Rewards Distribution (October)
### Overview:

This proposal continues the delegate compensation program first approved in [**\[SIP5.6\]**](https://forum.summer.fi/t/sip5-6-retroactive-compensation-for-delegates/229), this time applying it to **October 2025**. The goal is to sustain high-quality governance engagement and reward meaningful participation from active delegates across Lazy Summer Protocol governance.

> Extending [**\[SIP3.11\]**](https://forum.summer.fi/t/sip3-11-delegate-rewards-distribution-september/393) (September Distribution) to **\[SIP3.11.1]** (October Distribution) to **\[SIP3.11.X]** (Future Distributions)

***

### Motivation:

Active and accountable delegates remain a cornerstone of protocol governance. October 2025 featured discussions around SUMR transferability, Governance v2 audit progress, and multiple RFCs for new vaults and integrations. Compensating delegates for their time and contributions ensures continued accountability and engagement.

***

### Specification:



| Item                      | Value                                                                                                          |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Rewards Token             | [**SUMR**](https://basescan.org/token/0x194f360D130F2393a5E9F3117A6a1B78aBEa1624)                              |
| Source of Rewards         | Lazy Summer [**DAO Treasury**](https://basescan.org/address/0x447bf9d1485abdc4c1778025dfdfbe8b894c3796) (Base) |
| Total Distribution Amount | **154,249.98 SUMR**                                                                                            |
| Distribution Schedule     | One-time disbursement following onchain approval                                                               |
| Eligibility Period        | October 1st – October 31th (2025)                                                                              |
| Distribution Method       | Direct transfer to verified delegate wallet addresses                                                          |

***

### Risk Assessment:

* Onchain vote will authorize SUMR disbursement from the DAO Treasury.
* Delegate participation data was sourced from the [**Lazy Summer Governance Dashboard**](https://dune.com/lazysummer/lazy-summer-dao-governance).
* The final delegate list and breakdown is made publicly available [**here**](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTOcW98nSMK1XdSVZ268c3M6MCqY-xvlr7Ji1GUjk0v9V_iXJfrpqE1wxJW1JcvRAaSb6LApoz3xonx/pubhtml#gid=624253588).
* Any entity may only receive compensation through a single verified delegate address.
* Suspected Sybil delegates will be excluded, subject to verification by [@Recognized\_Delegates](https://forum.summer.fi/groups/recognized_delegates).

***

### Voting:

> If **YES** - Approve 154,249.98 SUMR disbursement to eligible October delegates

> If **NO** - Do not compensate for October; continue with further discussion.

The following payouts will be made as per this sheet - which details how much of each token the referring user and referred user earned as part of the campaign, and converts to USD at the time: [Lazy Summer Protocol Oct USDC and SUMR Referral Rewards](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1v4Urp10f95ok8eGG32LZT3yiY398qJDc9_Zul2qW_i8/edit?usp=sharing).

Upon successful vote, it will trigger a campaign creation on MERKL and transfer the required amount of SUMR and USDC to the claims contract which will then be made available to claim.
